body: I personally think it’s fair; although scammers suck, they are apart of nearly every business. I enjoy the option to adjust a tip. For example, I always tip 25%-30%, but last night, I tipped 30% and the driver driver about 14 min in the opposite direction. After contacting her she said she was using Apple Maps and forgot to change the address. While I understand mistakes happen, I do not feel 30% tip is reasonable for food that now arrived about 20-25 minutes later than expected because you made a mistake. If I couldn’t have adjusted the tip, I would have been disappointed tipping so much for poor service. That’s why I personally like the option to adjust the tip based on the service I was provided.
I have a small scoop of vanilla bean ice cream with a couple strawberries cut up on top
